attribution: The 'ok' reply restates a Federal Reserve Board statement in a few words (public domain, https://www.federalreserve.gov/disclaimer.htm); everything else is invented.
doc_facts: ':online' is documented as exactly equivalent to plugins [{"id": "web"}]; with no engine it uses native search for Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, Perplexity and SpaceXAI models, otherwise Exa.
engine 'native' always uses the provider's own search (may error if unsupported); engine 'exa' forces Exa at US$0.007 per request (auto mode).
Results come back as message.annotations of type url_citation with url, title, optional content, start_index, end_index.
usage.cost (credits, US$) is included in every response; usage: {include: true} is deprecated and has no effect.
Google native search returns 400 when domain filters are set with engine native; fbot sets no domain filters.
